Title: Stand-in Short Rifle
Author: Blockland ReImagined tests
Written for tests. It has the community Weapon_ShortRifleKai folder name and
the datablock and method names its port covers, built on the stand-in Tier 1
as the original is built on Tier 1, so the listed port applies to it. It is
not the original Add-On and holds none of its files; its names shown to
players, models and numbers are its own.
